div.span: After the first QueryExecutor completes its read-only call and records the step event (TAX_RATES_LOADED), SEC immediately invokes the Destination (FetchExchangeRateQueryExecutor) in the exact same thread without pausing. Because both steps are read-only queries, neither creates compensable rollback actions in the event-store.
